description: Create a new task in the estate. Use this when the user identifies a new requirement or action item that should be tracked.

asset_id.description: Optional asset ID to link the task to

deadline.description: Optional ISO date string for the deadline (e.g. 2026-03-15)

description.description: Detailed description of what needs to be done

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

task_category.description: Category of task (default estate_admin, use asset_specific when linked to an asset)

name: create_task
